notes.title: Notice : Pilgrimage of Compassion Stage Difficulty Adjustment Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

Difficulties for Stages LC-PC-11 and LC-PC-14 will be changed with enemy adjustments.

We determined that the Normal difficulty may be presenting too significant a challenge when it comes to defeating the enemies in those stages, even with Identity & E.G.O Level/Upgrade Tier adjustments.

Therefore, we are making adjustments to the Normal difficulty of the Pilgrimage of Compassion to allow for an easier experience when enjoying the story.

※ The Hotfix will be deployed without a separate client update, but please note that additional in-game downloads may occur.


Please continue reading for more information.


[Pilgrimage of Compassion Stage Difficulty Adjustments]
1. Stage LC-PC-11 enemy difficulty will be adjusted.

[In Normal, Hard difficulties both]
▶ Mid-battle Choice Event check requirements will be lowered.

[In Normal difficulty only]
▶ Enemies featured in this Stage will lose 5 levels.
※ Naturally, with this level adjustment, their Offense/Defense Levels and HP will be decreased.


2. Stage LC-PC-14 enemy difficulty will be adjusted.

[In Normal, Hard difficulties both]
▶ Reading priority marker will be added to one of the enemy Passives.
※ Affected Passive : Nethersea Brand Utopia

[In Normal difficulty only]
▶ The enemy will lose Defense Levels.
- Before : Level -0
- After : Level -5

▶ 'Tidal Arc' Skill effects will be adjusted.
(1) Power gain conditional adjusted
- Before : [On Use] For every 5 Nervous Impairment on target, consume 1 Abyssal Vitality to gain Clash Power +1 (max 5)
- After : [On Use] For every 10 Nervous Impairment on target, consume 1 Abyssal Vitality to gain Clash Power +1 (max 2)

(2) Coin 2 effect adjusted
- Before : Unbreakable Coin, [On Hit] Inflict 4 Nervous Impairment
- After : [On Hit] Inflict 2 Nervous Impairment

▶ 'Fierce Currents' Skill effects will be adjusted.
(1) Base Power adjusted
- Before : 4
- After : 3

(2) Coin 2 effect adjusted
- Before : [On Hit] Inflict 4 Nervous Impairment
- After : [On Hit] Inflict 2 Nervous Impairment

▶ 'Undulating Waves' Skill effects will be adjusted.
(1) Power gain conditional adjusted
- Before : [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 3 Nervous Impairment on the main target (max 9)
- After : [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Nervous Impairment on the main target (max 5)

(2) Coin 1 effect adjusted
- Before : [On Hit] Inflict 6 Nervous Impairment
- After : [On Hit] Inflict 4 Nervous Impairment


[Hotfix Deployment ETA]
- 09.26(Fri) 16:30(KST)
- There may be a 10-minute margin of error from the ETA.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice: FAQ Error Correction
notes.content:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

On September 4th 2025, 14:00 (KST), we identified an error in one of our FAQ categories.

Please continue reading for more information.

[ FAQ Error Corrections Category ]
How can I cancel / cancel my purchase / get a refund?

[ Original Text ]
- If it has been within 14 days since your purchase, and if you have not claimed the product(s) from your Inbox, we can assist you with your cancellation request.
However, we will be unable to process your cancellation in the following circumstances.
(1) 14 days have passed since the purchase
(2) If the product has been claimed from the inbox
(3) If the product is an item that is used immediately upon purchase (e.g. Season Pass)

[ Corrected Text ]
- If it has been within 7 days since your purchase, and if you have not claimed the product(s) from your Inbox, we can assist you with your cancellation request.
However, we will be unable to process your cancellation in the following circumstances.
(1) 7 days have passed since the purchase
(2) If the product has been claimed from the inbox
(3) If the product is an item that is used immediately upon purchase (e.g. Season Pass)


[ Cause for Correction ]
We realized that, according to the actual terms of service, cancellation is possible only within 7 days of your purchase, whereas the FAQ incorrectly labeled it as 14 days. Therefore, we have updated the FAQ to align with the actual terms of service.

[ Exceptions Notice ]
For the managers who have sent in a cancellation request prior to this correction notice, but haven't yet had their purchase refunded: if their purchase was made 7~14 days ago, we will make an exception by withdrawing the items from their Inbox and processing the refund.
※ Please note that, just as it was before, items that immediately go into effect after purchase, or the items that have been claimed from the Inbox, cannot be refunded.

Please take note of this and submit your cancellation request within 7 days of your purchase.

We sincerely apologize for this unintended confusion, and we promise to continue to strive to improve ourselves so that we can provide more accurate information going forward.

notes.title: Notice: July 31st Ver 1.83.0 Known Issues & Subsequent Measures
notes.content:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

In this notice, we would like to inform you about the causes and our measures toward issues that have been identified, in addition to the softlocking issue in our previous notice. With it, we would also like to inform you regarding our new client update.

▶ An issue where the game softlocks in certain Encounters

[ Cause ]
This issue was a side effect of fixing the issue where the targeting mechanism for Skills with the [Indiscriminate] trait did not work properly, the fix for which was deployed with today's Scheduled Update.

The side effect was that, when an enemy target uses a [Indiscriminate] Skill in Focused Encounters, we observed an abnormal legnthening of the targeting time, which caused the game to softlock.

[ Solution ]
We have identified the exact logic that was causing the issue,
and have tracked and corrected the cause of the error to properly address it.

[ Subsequent Measures ]
We will be adding a logic to preemptively detect other logics that are taking abnormally long to calculate.


▶ An issue where certain effects of the E.G.O Gift Omnivibro-octovecti-bell did not work properly
※ Relevant effect : extend the Tremor - Superposition on target at Turn End to the next turn

[ Cause ]
In Focused Encounters, the E.G.O Gift should have applied to each part of enemies, but it was applying Tremor - Superposition to the enemies themselves, which caused the relevant effects to not trigger.

[ Solution ]
We have adjusted the code so that the E.G.O Gift's effects apply to each part instead of the enemy itself in Focused Encounters.

[ Subsequent Measures ]
Going forward, we will be including an additional testing step to ensure that E.G.O Gift effects are applying to each Part in Focused Encounters, so that this issue won't occur again.



▶ New Client Deployment ETA

A new Client version(1.83.1) with fixes for the above issues will be deployed.

STEAM: The update will be deployed around 19:00 (KST).
iOS, Android: As Client updates need to go through the review process of each respective marketplaces, we will inform you again of the update schedule once the reviews are complete.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Notice: Balancing Adjustments for Certain Identities
notes.content:
Hello, this is Kim Jihoon, director at Project Moon.

I would like to inform you of upcoming adjustments to Red Sheet Sinclair’s Passive & Talisman effects,
and Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept Faust's Identity effects.


1. Lobotomy E.G.O::Red Sheet Sinclair

The Identity theme for this Season was intended to focus on the Rupture Keyword, and the Identities have been released based on that idea. However, due to the severe balancing issues that are closely tied to the overtuned abilities of Lobotomy E.G.O::Red Sheet Sinclair's Passive and Talisman effect, we have reached the conclusion that adjustments must be made.

We sincerely wished to avoid making any adjustments to Identities that have already been released.
However, the existence of the Lobotomy E.G.O::Red Sheet Sinclair's Passive and Talisman buff has severely affected our game design not only in regards to Rupture Identities, but the Keyword itself.

We have worked diligently to find various possible adjustments to avoid Rupture Identities overly synergizing with Red Sheet Sinclair,
but our attempts to do so has forced us to place several awkward limitations on the Rupture Keyword itself.
And this problem has become far more apparent with the current Season.


2. Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept Faust

We realized that this unit's damage output was far too high compared to that of other units, which was not our initial design intent;
therefore, we mean to make adjustments to address this issue.

Our initial intent was to have this unit use its Empowered Skill every 3~5 turns,
similar to the other units who have Empowered Skills.
However, due to the mistake in the design process and the lack of testing, we ended up setting the values incorrectly.

This mistake has made the Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Faust's Empowered Skill 3 Activation conditional far too low,
which means that it can use a Skill that was intended to be used every 3-5 turns, every single turn in Focused Encounters.

Therefore, in order to address this issue, we will be raising the required amount of 'Tianjiu Star's Blade' Stack to use the Empowered Skill 3, and the amount consumed when using it.
It will be adjusted so that it can be used every 2~3 turns, considering the unit's current capabilities.



3. In Conclusion

In the process of testing and prioritizing the combat encounters and cutscenes of Canto 8,
I as the director made requests for several urgent additions in terms of story cutscenes and gameplay elements.

Due to this, our combat design team was preoccupied with adding and testing these new additions,
which means that they physically did not have enough time to sufficiently test this Identity.
That is what has led to this current situation where we have the Rupture Keyword synergy and Identity's powers breaking the game's balancing.

I am terribly sorry for having to frequently make these negative adjustments to these Identities and E.G.O that our users have been using for their powerful capabilities.

I made an announcement to never change the texts and values of already-released Identities
back when The Ring Student Yi Sang was released.
However, regretfully and shamefully, I will have to go against what I had said earlier.

This decision was made with the belief that proper game balancing increases the players' immersion,
which leads to immersion with the game's story itself.
However, I would like to express that I am terribly regretful that this change may hurt the immersion and expectation of many of our users who have been looking forward to and enjoying Canto 8.

It is especially unfortunate, as this mistake was made in the same vein as the case with The Ring Student Yi Sang.

We will put further care into our Identity and E.G.O designs going forward, in effort to prevent similar issues from occurring again.

With the May 29th (KST) Scheduled Update, Lobotomy E.G.O::Red Sheet Sinclair and Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept Faust's levels and Uptie Tiers will be reset for all managers.

notes.title: Notice: Custom Language Translation Support
notes.content:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

Currently, Limbus Company supports a total of three languages: Korean, English, and Japanese.
Unfortunately, as this is a live service game, it is difficult for us to add official support for additional languages while simultaneously working on constant updates.

Therefore, in order to ensure that players can access the game with better convenience, we intend to add support for custom unofficial translation mods.

Please view the steps below for a guide on how to install custom translation mods; we intend to apply gradual improvements to this function as well.
If future updates or improvements for this function are deployed, we will inform you via an additional update.

We wish to express our most sincere gratitude to everyone playing Limbus Company, and we will try our best so that you can have a better experience enjoying our game.

Thank you.



1. Install the newest version of Limbus Company and find the installation folder. (starting from Version 1.73.0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/06813ceba5c911133ae77463d462581c8a5aee7b.png[/img]

2. Find "LimbusCompany_Data/Assets/Resources_moved/Localize/" folder.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/9f04c281b253bbd70d97c58cad7689f65617673a.png[/img]

3. Verify the original folders and files(kr, en, jp), copy the aforementioned files, and apply your translations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/6929ac17acf19fcea136f3222f127893cce985e2.png[/img]

4. Find the "LimbusCompany_Data/Lang" directory. If the 'Lang' folder doesn't exist, make one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/08d55e4405b1c3592e4e00f5137885397f376617.png[/img]

5. Make a new folder and designate a name.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/92d7031f49fe9205179b4f32a43a2ec8d58c4806.png[/img]

6. Add your translated files to the folder.
  - The structure of the folder must be identical to the original files.
  - Please remove the prefixes in the json file names.
  - (X) KR_MainUIText.json, EN_MainUIText.json, JP_MainUIText.json
  - (O) MainUIText.json
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/0e494699f9f4255718db2e5540b7863e913d8ce3.png[/img]

7. Within the same folder, create a "Font" folder, and add your prepared fold files into the said folder.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/2ca83ef18e06c95bd757738370c6feacd4f049ad.png[/img]

8. Find the "Lang" folder again, and adjust the contents of 'config.json'. If the file does not exist, make one and fill the contents as seen in this screenshot.
  - This file looks for the folder with its name written in the file and runs the game with your language of choice.
  - The contents of the config file must match the top folder name of your translation files.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/6e7677f79fc7bdb7f9e8f3d230f63608d5772e0f.png[/img]

9. Run the game and verify that the translations have been applied properly.
  - e.g.) Try changing the text in the button at the bottom left corner of the screen.
  - Original: Clear all caches
  - Changed: Custom Translation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/9e9bff3bbfde8b5f48cafd1c23a43ab343be6593.png[/img]


Note) If you have applied 2 or more languages, use the "Select Custom Language" button to choose the language you would like to play the game with.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/8cf1a3ee216609e53f4cae03278e960962d422b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43587230/c913d30f856b722541f2c5f87ae778c2fb5226d6.png[/img]

notes.title: Dec. 19th Scheduled Update Hotfix Notice
notes.content:
[Dec. 19th Scheduled Update Hotfix Notice]

Greetings, dear Manager.

With the Dec. 19th Scheduled Update, a function to add letterboxes in combat encounters to fix the aspect ratio in combat has been added to the game.

We informed you in the Update Notice with the text “Addressed the issue where the “Resolution adjustment in combat gameplay” does not work as intended”, but we failed to word it clearly enough to inform the players what this was referring to, making it seem as though the letterboxes were caused by a glitch.

We sincerely apologize for causing you inconvenience in combat due to this new function.
The following are explanations of our intent, solution, and future improvements regarding this function.

[Intent]
- We added the letterboxes to address the following issues caused by varying aspect ratios: where enemy and ally placements could be misaligned, where Abnormality sprites could appear broken, or where each unit’s Skill Slots may not appear fully on the screen. We sought to solve this issue by making sure that every device runs on the same aspect ratio.

[Issue]
- We realized that adding large letterboxes depending on the aspect ratio could cause the display to appear small, causing inconvenience on the players’ side.
- An additional issue occurred where additional adjustment of resolution after entering a combat scene could cause the screen to appear incorrectly as the letterboxing aspect ratio was not adjusted accordingly.

[Solution]
- We intend to revert this change and remove the letterboxing with an upcoming hotfix today.

[Future Measures]
- We will improve the letterboxing setting logic and add a separate option to enable/disable this function with a future update.
- We will inform you via a scheduled notice before applying the said update.

[Hotfix Deployment]
The hotfix will be applied without a separate client update; restart the game to apply the hotfix. Please note that additional in-game downloads may occur, however.

Content
▶ Removes the letterboxing functionality in combat scenes when using aspect ratios narrower than 16:9

Deployment ETA
▶ 12.19(FRI) 18:30(KST) - There may be a 10 minute margin of error to this estimation.


We are currently investigating other issues that have occurred as well, and we are working on fixes for those issues as well.
Further adjustments and fixes will be announced via the 12.23(MON) Scheduled Update Notice.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

<List of Changes Deploying with the Hotfix>

<List of Changes Deploying with the Hard Update>
※ The following changes will be applied to the game with the 24.12.05 (KST) Scheduled Update.

1. Players will now be able to select 2 or more Grace of Stars at once, as long as their Rest Bonus stock allows
- Cannot stack two identical effects over one another.

2. Guarantees 60 'Starter Buff Cost'
- Even without the Rest Bonus from rested Identities, players will have a base value of 60 'Starter Buff Cost' to purchase the Grace of Stars. The sum of 'Starter Buff Cost' and maximized Identity Rest Bonus adds up to 120.

The Rest Bonus system was implemented to encourage the use of multiple loadouts.
However, the system as it is now discourages players from enjoying the Mirror Dungeon
as players with only a single loadout or with few loadouts cannot gain much Passives
or bonuses from the Grace of Stars.
We failed to see this during the early stages of our design, and this issue occurred due to our inadequacies. We will be sure to continue refining ourselves and improving the game.

In order to adjust the current Mirror Dungeon, and to have its issues addressed without deviating from our original intent, we intend to add the base Rest Bonus to purchase the Grace of Stars and adjust the way the system works.

Issue

- Progressing through the Story Dungeon with the said loadout will cause the black screen progression blocker issue

- In the progress of limiting the deployment of Don Quixote in all Story Dungeons, the logic to implement that interfered with the logic that deploys Friend Support Units, which caused the black screen progression blocker issue.

- Upon first entry to the dungeon: please do not deploy a Friend Support Unit in your loadout.
- In the in-dungeon Checkpoints: please do not deploy a Friend Support Unit in your loadout.

If the issue is already occurring, and if you are already inside the dungeon, please forfeit the dungeon and enter again with a new loadout.

How to forfeit a dungeon 
- Select the cogwheel on the top right corner of the Dungeon UI, and select "Forfeit" in the subsequent options menu.
- If there is an issue preventing you from attempting the above fix: attempt to enter a different Story Dungeon, and once the "You're currently exploring (Other Dungeon)'. Forfeit your progress and enter a new dungeon?" popup appears, press "Yes".


We will update you via an additional notice as soon as we resolve this issue.

1. An issue where the game softlocks in combat under certain circumstances

We have identified a softlocking issue in our latest Client version(1.57.1) where the game would become unresponsive during a combat encounter.
This issue occurs for enemies with certain patterns, and we are currently reviewing, investigating, and fixing content that may be affected by this issue.

[Issues identified in the Sep. 19th Scheduled Update]

Hello,
This is Project Moon.

The following are issues that have been identified in the Sep. 19th Scheduled Update(version 1.57.0)

1. An issue where, in a Main Story Chaptter 5 Boss fight, turns would infinitely grow without letting the players or the enemies take any action
Cause: This was a side effect that occurred as we were developing a new system, and it occurred in this update. This occurs when the turn where the ‘Assisted Defense’ was used, but if a certain enemy was defeated by effects such as “Burn” in the same turn.
Solution: We corrected the logic in the corresponding boss pattern.

2. An issue where Lobotomy E.G.O::Lantern Don Quixote’s Coin Reuse for Skill 3 would activate repeatedly
Cause: This was a side effect that occurred due to a new system affecting the Reuse logic, and it occurred in this update.
Solution: We identified the problematic Reuse logic, and we resolved it by correcting the said logic.

3. An issue where, as the player is making inputs to the UI while using an E.G.O, using the shortcut keys would immediately cause the combat phase to begin
Cause: This was caused because the game intercepts both the mouse controls and the shortcut key controls at the same time. It occurred after we implemented the shortcut key system to the game.
Solution: We adjusted the logic so that shortcut keys won’t activate when controlling the game with a mouse.

4. An issue where, after Evading an attack, if 2+ allies would Evade an enemy’s AOE attack, the game would softlock
Cause: There was an error in the preexisting system. We assume that this issue occurred sometime before this current update. It occurs when 2+ allies who can reuse their Evade Skills after successfully evading once are targeted by AOE attacks. 
Solution: We identified the problematic Evade Reuse logic, and we resolved it by correcting the said logic.

장기적인 운영을 위해서도 어떤 성능으로 인격,에고가 나와도 출시한 이상 버그가 아닌 경우 너프를 진행하는 경우가 없도록 하겠습니다.

[ 약지 스튜던트 이상 /  약지 스튜던트 오티스 인격 성능 일부 조정 안내 ]

안녕하세요. 프로젝트문 디렉터 김지훈입니다.

이번에도 기획과 구현의 미숙으로 약지 스튜던트 이상과 약지 스튜던트 오티스가 의도에 맞지 않게 거울던전에서 모든 키워드 기프트의 효과를 받게 되었습니다.


해당 인격들이 거울던전에서 모든 키워드 기프트의 효과를 받는 것은 예상치 못한 기획 실수입니다

약지 이상, 오티스는 출혈 키워드 기프트에만 영향을 받도록 하는 것이 의도였습니다.

또한 약지는 파벌에 따라 한 키워드에 어느 정도 특화되지만, 동시에 여러 키워드를 부여함으로써 최종적으로 한 도화지에 여러 키워드가 칠해져 추후 다양하고 독특한 효과를 내는 것을 도슨트, 마에스트로 인격에서 여러 약지 인격들의 효과와 함께 완성하는 것이 목표였습니다. 

하지만 현재 구현된 약지 스튜던트 이상은 점묘파의 메인 키워드인 출혈 외에도 여러 키워드 기프트들의 효과를 받음으로써 어떤 조합에 들어가도 상위권에 위치하는 오버파워적인 성능을 가지게 되었습니다.

또한 이는 키워드별로 특화된 인격과 에고에 따른 덱의 다양성을 만들고자하는 거울던전에서의 플레이 경험과 너무나도 어긋난 상황입니다.


추가적으로 약지의 컨셉은 적에게 다양하게 부여된 디버프의 수와 위력의 조건으로 성능을 강해지는 것을 의도로 했으나, 적에게 부여된 디버프의 수량 조건이 다른 인격에 비해 조건달성하기 쉽게 설정되어 너무나도 쉽게 최대치의 성능이 나오게 된 것도 문제였습니다.

제가 이러한 부분을 빌드 마지막 날에 기획팀장과 기획자분을 통해 이야기를 한 번 더 나누고 빌드직전에 의도대로 되었는지를 확인해야 했는데, 이번에 그러지 못했습니다.


결과적으로 초기에 의도했던 약지의 컨셉과는 다르게 구현되고 반영되었습니다.

이러한 상황이 발생한 이유로는 제가 생각한 의도를 기획팀에 명확히 전달하지 못했고, 중간과 마무리 단계에서도 지속적으로 체크를 하지 못하여 발생한 문제입니다.


최근 잦은 사양 변경으로 인해 이번만큼은 인격의 성능을 변경하고 싶지 않았으나, 어떤 조합에 들어가도 특정 키워드에 특화된 인격까지 상회하는 성능을 발휘하는 인격은 방치하면 안 된다는 판단을 하였습니다. 

너무나도 송구스러운 마음입니다.


약지 이상,오티스의 성능적인 조정이 들어간 만큼 동기화를 진행하신 분들에게는 동기화를 초기화하여 그만큼의 동기화 재료를 반납하여 지급해 드리겠습니다.

밸런스 조정의 목표는 '3성 에드가 가문 치프 버틀러 료슈' 정도의 성능을 목표로 하여 성능이 급락한 경험을 하시지 않도록 조정하겠습니다.


약지 이상의 경우 하단과 같이 밸런스를 조정할 예정입니다.

1. 약지 이상이 랜덤으로 부여하는 키워드 표기 방식을 변경( 랜덤으로 부여하는 키워드에 해당하는 기프트 효과는 적용받지 않도록) --> EGO 어느날갑자기, 홀리데이와는 다르게

2. 약지 이상의 스킬2 - 혈점묘화의 재사용 조건을 너프 --> 스킬2의 경우 재사용으로 인한 피해량이 높음과 동시에, 합의 위력도 높아서 전천후적인 스킬이 되어버렸습니다. 코인 재사용 효과는 더 신중하게 수치를 넣도록 하겠습니다. 위력은 유지한채, 조건을 강화하는 방식으로 최대한 성능적 상실감을 느끼지 않도록 조정하겠습니다.

3. 약지 이상의 스킬3 - 부정적인 효과 갯수의 고정적 수치 이상이 아닌 부정적인 효과 수에 비례해서 성능이 조정되도록 하겠습니다. 약지의 컨셉이 부정적인 효과를 다채롭게 칠하고, 그 수에 따라 강해지거나 효과를 부여하는것이 의도였으나, 지금은 정해진 부정적인 효과의 수만 넘으면 고정된 최고 성능이 나오기 때문에 약지의 컨셉과 맞지 않게 구현되었습니다.


구체적인 조정 방안은 내일중으로 기획팀과 정리하여 다시 한번 알려드리도록 하겠습니다.



- 약지 스튜던트 이상 / 약지 스튜던트 오티스를 동기화 하신분들에게는 동기화를 초기화한만큼 동일한 재화를 지급해드리도록 하겠습니다.

- 잦은 인격의 사양 변경으로 인한 송구스러운 마음으로 1300 광기의 보상을 지급하겠습니다.


여러번 돌이켜봐도 제가 컨셉과 의도를 정한만큼 끝까지 한번이라도 체크하는 시간을 가졌어야 했는데 안일한 마음으로 그러한 과정을 거치지 않고 나태한 마음으로 방관한 책임이 가장 크다고 생각합니다.

이유가 어떻든 좋은 성능의 캐릭터를 사용하시다가 너프되었을때의 상실감과 분노를 알기 때문에 더욱 죄송한 마음이 큽니다.

프로젝트의 규모 커지고, 즐겨주시는 팬분들이 많아진 만큼, 기획과 구현 공정 시스템을 체계적으로 가다듬겠습니다.

플레이어분들에게 너무나 죄송한 마음이 크고, 최근 빈번한 사양 변경 공지로 디렉터인 제 스스로도 너무나 많은 부족함을 느끼고 있습니다.

다시 한번 사과의 말씀드립니다.

하지만 현재 구현된 약지 스튜던트 이상은 점묘파의 메인 키워드인 출혈 외에도 여러 키워드 기프트들의 효과를 받음으로써 어떤 조합에 들어가도 상위권에 위치하는 오버파워적인 성능을 가지게 되었습니다.
추가적으로 약지의 컨셉은 적에게 다양하게 부여된 디버프의 수와 위력의 조건으로 성능을 강해지는 것을 의도로 했으나, 적에게 부여된 디버프의 수량 조건이 다른 인격에 비해 조건달성하기 쉽게 설정되어 너무나도 쉽게 최대치의 성능이 나오게 된 것도 문제였습니다.
약지 이상,오티스의 성능적인 조정이 들어간 만큼 동기화를 진행하신 분들에게는 동기화를 초기화하여 그만큼의 동기화 재료를 반납하여 지급해 드리겠습니다.
밸런스 조정의 목표는 '3성 에드가 가문 치프 버틀러 료슈' 정도의 성능을 목표로 하여 성능이 급락한 경험을 하시지 않도록 조정하겠습니다.
약지 이상의 경우 하단과 같이 밸런스를 조정할 예정입니다.
1. 약지 이상이 랜덤으로 부여하는 키워드 표기 방식을 변경( 랜덤으로 부여하는 키워드에 해당하는 기프트 효과는 적용받지 않도록) --> EGO 어느날갑자기, 홀리데이와는 다르게
2. 약지 이상의 스킬2 - 혈점묘화의 재사용 조건을 너프 --> 스킬2의 경우 재사용으로 인한 피해량이 높음과 동시에, 합의 위력도 높아서 전천후적인 스킬이 되어버렸습니다. 코인 재사용 효과는 더 신중하게 수치를 넣도록 하겠습니다. 위력은 유지한채, 조건을 강화하는 방식으로 최대한 성능적 상실감을 느끼지 않도록 조정하겠습니다.
3. 약지 이상의 스킬3 - 부정적인 효과 갯수의 고정적 수치 이상이 아닌 부정적인 효과 수에 비례해서 성능이 조정되도록 하겠습니다. 약지의 컨셉이 부정적인 효과를 다채롭게 칠하고, 그 수에 따라 강해지거나 효과를 부여하는것이 의도였으나, 지금은 정해진 부정적인 효과의 수만 넘으면 고정된 최고 성능이 나오기 때문에 약지의 컨셉과 맞지 않게 구현되었습니다.

[Notice: Mirror Dungeon Enemy HP & Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair adjustment Hotfix]

The hotfix for Mirror Dungeon Enemy HP & Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair adjustments will be deployed at 23:00 (KST) today.
We will inform you via an additional notice as soon as it is deployed.

The hotfix will be deployed after restarting the game without a separate client update. However, please note that an additional in-game download may occur.

Please refer to the information below for more details on the adjustments.

1. Mirror Dungeon Enemy HP Adjustments
The following Mirror Dungeon enemies' HP have been adjusted.
- Steam Transport Machine
- Wayward Passenger
- Distorted Bamboo-hatted Kim
- Faelantern
- Dongrang, Who Denies All
- Effloresced E.G.O::Farmwatch
- Nelly
- Effloresced E.G.O::Dongbaek
- Spiral of Contempt
- Dead Rabbits Boss
- Ahab/Queequeg/Starbuck
- Effloresced E.G.O::Gasharpoon
-  Ardor Blossom Moth
- Drenched Gossypium


2. Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair Adjustments

Our intent in designing Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair was to have an unstable SP character with a high Skill Power ceiling. 
However, we observed that the instability caused much more frustration than we had intended.
This was especially true for situations in which Sinclair could not Clash with the enemies or if the enemies had abilities that could lower their SP.
Basically, the situations in which the player could not control the allies' SP.
In our testing phase, we ran the tests with a SP-healing team that could support his SP loss, so we failed to catch this issue.
This led to this character being far too weak in teams that weren't focused on SP healing, which we intend to address.

- The following SP heal/loss conditions will be adjusted.
Before : Increase by 15 after defeating an enemy whose level was higher than this unit's.
After : Increase by 10 after defeating an enemy whose level was higher than this unit's. Also, it increases by 15 after defeating an enemy regardless of the enemy's level.

- Skill 1 'Fierce Charge' no longer consumes SP.

- Defensive Skill 'Rue' no longer consumes SP.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Notice: Server Error Fixes & Mirror Dungeon Improvements
notes.content:
[Notice: Server Error Fixes & Mirror Dungeon Improvements]

Hello,
This is Project Moon.

In this notice, we would like to inform you regarding the server errors that have occurred after the May 2nd 12:00 (KST) Scheduled Update, and upcoming improvements to the Mirror Dungeon.


1. Server Error Fixes

After the May 2nd 12:00 (KST) Scheduled Update, we identified an issue where an abnormal frequency of server errors prevented players from progressing through the game normally. This issue has now been corrected.

Over 100,000 server login requests were made immediately after the maintenance completion, which caused the server system to overload and malfunction. This was the cause of the in-game server error popup messages.
We have taken temporary measures to stabilize the server.

Please refer to the following for more details.

<Cause>
- Abrupt rise in login attempts within a short span of time
- The sudden rise in login attempts sent a relatively large amount of data requests to the server
- The amount of data was too much for the server to process, causing the systems to overload and malfunction

<Solution>
The following functions have been temporarily limited to stabilize the server.
- Temporarily disabled Account deletion
- Temporarily deleted the notification function for new Friend requests in the main UI (by the user banner on the bottom left side of the screen)
We will monitor the server systems for a while before enabling the above functions again.
We will inform you via an additional notice regarding the above measures.

<Future measures>
- We plan to conduct hardware stabilization and logic optimization work so that the server system will function normally even with multiple concentrated requests.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. 



2. Mirror Dungeon Improvements

We are closely monitoring the Managers' opinions regarding the difficulty of Mirror Dungeon - Mirror of the Wuthering.
Several adjustments, including balancing adjustments, will be deployed to the Mirror Dungeon after continued observation of your experiences.
We will inform you of the Mirror Dungeon improvements via a notice.

Our intent in planning this Mirror Dungeon was to slowly ease the difficulty as more and more Starter Buffs are unlocked, which would eventually lead to a similar level of difficulty and playtimes.
As we have informed you via our previous notice, this Mirror Dungeon may feel more difficult compared to the previous Mirror Dungeon due to the loss of access to the following modifiers: Types of E.G.O Gifts, Numbers, Enhancement Levels, Owned Cost, and Damage Dealt.

However, we did notice that several enemies that appear in the earlier stages of the Dungeon have abnormally high HP, so their HP will be adjusted via a hotfix.
This issue occurred because certain enemies from other content, such as Refraction Railway, did not have their HP scaling applied to them in the process; this led to their HP being higher than it should be at that point in the Mirror Dungeon.
We apologize for the troubles the higher enemy HP may have caused in your Mirror Dungeon experience.
We will notify you via an additional notice as soon as it is deployed.

An additional notice will be posted later today regarding additional changes that will be deployed to the Mirror Dungeon.
We sincerely apologize for causing these balancing issues and complications with every Mirror Dungeon update.
We will make sure to improve these issues so that you will have a more positive experience with our content.

Recipients : All users whose accounts were created before May 16th 2024, 10:00
Can be claimed once per Account
When : After May 2nd 2024, 17:00

notes.title: [Emergency Notice] Notice : Issues after Jan. 11th Scheduled Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Project Moon.
We would like to inform you about the issues that have been identified after the Jan. 11th Scheduled Update, and our subsequent measures regarding them.

[b]1. An issue where the game freezes in certain Focused Encounters[/b]

[Issue Details]
- (Focused Encounter) When an enemy that is scheduled to attack is killed, the game freezes.
(Ambling Pearl, Shock Centipede, Doomsday Calendar, King Trash Crab, Skin Prophet, Become Strong? Genuinely?, Pink Shoes, etc etc)

[Cause]
- In order to optimize, we deleted several unnecessary logs from the game. However, in the process, we mistakenly deleted logs that were still being used by the game as well.

[Solution]
- Corrected the code so that the deleted logs are not used.
- Temporary Solution: For combat encounters with summoned units, kill all summoned units first. Defeat the Boss unit when it's the only remaining enemy in the stage.


[b]2. An issue where using the skip battle function in the Thread & EXP Luxcavations caused UI to glitch[/b]

[Issue Details]
- This issue can be reproduced by going straight to the Luxcavations and choosing to skip battle immediately after starting the game. (results screen only displays white images)
- After this issue occurs, the Main UI of the game, such as Window or Drive will not function properly.
- Using the skip battle function after completing other encounters normally does not cause this issue, and the Main UI of the game will function normally.

[Cause]
- This issue occurred because viewing the encounter result screen without a single deployed unit (like in skipped battles) did not properly load the data.
- This is a side effect of programming in The 2nd Walpurgis Night encounter result screen.

[Solution]
- We have corrected the code that caused this issue to occur.

The above two issues require a client build to be corrected.
We will work as fast as we can to correct the issue, prepare the build, and submit it so that you can play our game without these issues.

[b]We will update the game immediately on STEAM,

but iOS and Android require us to submit the build for review first. We will inform you with an additional notice as soon as we pass the review and the new versions are made available to those platforms.[/b]

We are also currently investigating the below issues.
We will inform you of the solutions and the subsequent measures regarding them as soon as we identify their causes.

[b][Issues currently under investigation][/b]
- An issue where completing a Luxcavation stage after clearing 'The Dawn of Green' encounter causes the game UI to overlap
- An issue where Lobotomy E.G.O::Magic Bullet Outis' lines do not match up with her voice lines
- An issue where the new Identities' Illustrations are unavailable under the 'Walpurgis Night' tag in the Player Ticket UI

We sincerely apologize for causing a disturbance to your enjoyment of our game.

[b][Jan. 11th Scheduled Update Error Compensation][/b]
- Compensation : Lunacy x1300
- Recipients : All users whose accounts were created before Jan. 25th 2024 10:00
- Can be claimed once per account
- When : Before the end of day on Jan. 11th 2024 (KST)
